notes:
Summary: Large pharma R&D + regulated clinical operations. Primary ask: fully private VPC/on-prem variant that can run air-gapped in manufacturing and clinical sites. Must satisfy 1) no egress of PHI/IP, 2) integration with on-prem HSM/KMS, 3) audit logs retained 7 years, 4) data residency constraints for EU trial data.

Quoted from CIO: "We cannot have any outbound telemetry during model inference in lab networks — plan for air-gapped installs and on-prem KMS only."

POC scope (requested): 3-node on-prem cluster (GPU or CPU fallback), Redwood Private control plane in customer VPC, offline installer image, no external telemetry, local HSM for key wrap, audit log shipping to Splunk instance in the same network. Acceptance criteria: throughput ~50 qps for batch reranking; 95th p90 chat latency <300ms for internal prompts; demonstrable KMS/HSM key rotation workflow; no outbound connections in air-gapped mode.

Security notes: completed initial ISO questionnaire (v0.9) — fields flagged: "HSM key custody", "legal controls for patient data export", "retention and deletion SLAs", and "SSO provisioning timeline". IT wants a stubbed runbook for offline upgrades and rollback.

Operational asks: installer ISO, offline RBAC user provisioning, Helm chart for on-prem operators, explicit network ports list, and expected disk IO for KV cache. Legal asked for a model governance appendix (what models are allowed for clinical data).

Next comms: Maya to send air-gap checklist + network diagram template; Diego to prepare HSM integration options (Azure Dedicated HSM vs. local Thales). Procurement expects SOW revision by 2025-12-15.

Stated constraints: high cost sensitivity for sustained inference; willing to trade model size (quantized) for determinism and faster p95. Prefer Redwood-driven rollout but needs customer-controlled upgrade windows.
use_case_summary: Stratus will use Redwood Private for two primary workloads: secure document search across regulatory binders and clinical notes (embeddings + reranking), and an internal chat assistant for R&D teams with strict IP controls. Secondary: summarization pipeline for regulatory submissions that must keep EU trial data within EU-controlled storage. High compliance bar — solution must pass InfoSec and Legal pre-procurement checks.
requirements: KMS integration: support for customer HSM (PKCS#11) and key wrap; no cloud KMS required
Audit logging: immutable logs forwarded to local Splunk/ELK; retention 7 years
Data residency: ability to restrict storage and logs to EU/NA boundaries per dataset
No outbound telemetry in air-gapped mode; optional telemetry when explicitly enabled
Operator access: RBAC via SSO (SAML) with SCIM provisioning support
Model controls: pin model versions, quantization recommendations, canary rollouts with automatic fallback
